description: This file defines a test runner class for executing Cucumber scenarios sequentially, specifically those tagged with '@sequential'. It configures the test execution environment, including features location, glue code packages, reporting plugins, and execution tags to ensure that certain scenarios run without parallelization to prevent data conflicts.

classes.name: SequentialTestRunner
classes.description: A JUnit test class configured with Cucumber annotations to run specified test scenarios sequentially.

methods.name: SequentialTestRunner
methods.description: Default constructor of the class; remains empty as the class serves as a configuration runner.
